test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: An integrated scheme for school education, 'Samagra Shiksha Scheme' of the Government of India has been continued for which of the following periods?
solution:
The correct answer is **"__2021-22 to 2025-26__".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Centrally Sponsored Scheme-Samagra Shiksha Scheme**, an integrated programme for the** school education sector,** would **continue from 1 April 2021 to 31 March 2026** with an anticipated **investment of 294283.04 crores,** according to the **Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs**.
 
• **To achieve** inclusive and equitable, high-quality, holistic schooling, the **Scheme is in line with the Sustainable Development Goal for Education (SDG-4)** and has now been **connected with the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020.**
 
• It strives to **guarantee** that **all children have access to high-quality education** in a fair and inclusive classroom setting that accommodates their diverse backgrounds, language requirements, and range of academic skills while also empowering them to actively engage in the learning process.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **These are the main goals of the Scheme:**

 
 
• Help states and UTs put the ideas in the National Education Policy 2020 into action (NEP 2020).
 
• The right of Children to Free and Mandatory Education (RTE) Act, 2009, says that all children have the right to free and required education.
 
• Pay attention to care and education for young children.
 
• The focus is on basic reading and math skills.
 
• 
 
Focus on a holistic, integrated, inclusive, and activity-based curriculum and pedagogy to teach students 21st century skills.
